# Strapi

> > Strapi is an open-source Node.js headless CMS with AI-powered features, enabling developers to design APIs fast, manage content easily, and deploy to Strapi Cloud.

Strapi provides a complete content management ecosystem including the core CMS (currently Strapi 5), extensive documentation, a marketplace for plugins and extensions, cloud hosting, and AI-powered tools like content type builders and translations. The platform supports TypeScript, GraphQL, React, and integrates seamlessly with frameworks like Next.js.

## Key Topics

- Strapi 5 (latest version)
- Headless CMS
- Node.js & TypeScript
- Strapi Cloud (managed hosting)
- Content-Type Builder
- REST & GraphQL APIs
- Next.js integration
- AI-powered features (translations, content generation)
- RBAC (Role-Based Access Control)
- Open-source CMS
- Content Manager
- Migration from Strapi 4 to 5
- Quick start & deployment
- Strapi Market (plugins & extensions)

- [With Strapi, design APIs fast, manage content easily.](https://strapi.io/why-strapi): Value proposition page explaining Strapi's headless CMS capabilities

- [Upgrading to Strapi 5 - Introduction and FAQ | Strapi 5 Documentation](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/migration/v4-to-v5/introduction-and-faq): Migration guide & FAQ for upgrading from Strapi 4 to Strapi 5
- [Transitioning From Strapi 4 to Strapi 5](https://strapi.io/blog/commonly-asked-questions-transitioning-from-strapi-4-to-strapi-5): FAQ: Strapi 4 to 5 migration with Document System & breaking changes
